definitionZh: 动画方向 CSS 属性设定动画是向前播放,向后播放,还是向后播放顺序之间交替播放.
sourceDefinition: The animation-direction CSS property sets whether an animation should play forward, backward, or alternate back and forth between playing the sequence forward and backward.
